reason: Project lens, checked by building it (scratch worktree at HEAD 9f97ad5, candidate applied): ship, release, bench (DEBUG_LIVES), full (DEBUG_LIVES,DEBUG_FULLREDRAW), gameplay, SKY_HELI=0 and DEBUG_FULLREDRAW+SKY_HELI=0 all assemble; bank 4's SKIP PAD_END sits at B383 ship, B3FF full (1 byte left of REN_BASE B400), B3CA gameplay, B3FD/B3FF sky_heli0: it fits everywhere. Listing: ds_c = &CC (zero page), so next_c + 4 = 9C98 BIT dm_flip, past DEC ds_c (2) / BEQ done (2); BEQ ren_draw_sprite.drawn resolves to the RTS at 9B74 (same page). Not PROTECTED, not a generated source, no data/table/RAM moved, not raster-timed; same bank-4 code, same ROMSEL/ANDY/ACCCON state, reads and writes the same RAM (col_ptr &C7/&C8, ds_c &CC). No caller uses A or C after ren_draw_sprite (draw_mover's parts, render 1383, sky.6502:261 all reload); col_ptr is read only inside ren_draw_sprite/draw_column, which reloads it per part; &C7/&C8 are not in restore_game_zp (zplive: the logic writes them before reading after a render; the prebuild's &C8 read is the case it marks unusable), and the renderer's final col_ptr already varies with whichever part was drawn last, so no new dependence. Front end, game over, completion, define controls do not reach the renderer's draw_column differently. Recount: non-last empty column 27 -> 25 cycles (2 saved), last empty column 28 -> 8 (20 saved), consistent with the claimed 7 average (~28% last) and the measured 28/34 a pass; +6 bytes (16 -> 22).
